mapper.select: SELECT ifnull(sum(room_count),0) FROM `room_order_record` r WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND #{searchDate} >= r.`start_time` AND #{searchDate} < r.`end_time`

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(r.room_count), 0) FROM room_order_record r INNER JOIN shops_room sr ON r.room_id = sr.room_id WHERE sr.shop_id = #{shopId} AND sr.room_type_id = #{roomTypeId} AND #{searchDate} >= r.start_time AND #{searchDate} < r.end_time
